label: plane
summary: Fixed-wing aircraft photographed in flight, parked on aprons, or framed against bright sky and runway horizons.
visual_clues: Swept or straight wing silhouette intersecting a tubular fuselage
Uniform sky-blue or overcast upper background with distinct horizon contrast
Tail fin vertical stabilizer or metallic jet engine nacelle geometry
imaging_notes: At 32x32 resolution, small distant airliners share sky textures with soaring birds; fuselage symmetry separates them.

label: car
summary: Passenger sedans, coupes, sports cars, and hatchbacks seen on roads, driveways, or street curbs.
visual_clues: Low cabin profile with angled windshield and rear window glass
Visible circular wheel wells close to asphalt or pavement shadow
Horizontal grille, headlamps, or bumper bar across the lower frame
imaging_notes: Head-on or three-quarter passenger cars can resemble pickup trucks or vans if cargo height is obscured.

label: bird
summary: Passerines, raptors, waterfowl, and ostriches captured perched on branches, wading in reeds, or gliding in flight.
visual_clues: Slender legs, webbed feet, or curved beak silhouette near head
Textured plumage against foliage, water, or open sky
Compact oval torso or outstretched feathered wingspan
imaging_notes: Brown songbirds on bark overlap color-wise with frogs and deer, making shape context and skip features crucial.

label: cat
summary: Domestic shorthair, tabby, and longhair cats indoors, curled up, or facing the camera at close range.
visual_clues: Triangular pointed ears framing a rounded forehead and short muzzle
Whisker contrast and vertical pupil or bright tapetum reflections
Compact curled or crouched posture on soft domestic backgrounds
imaging_notes: Cat vs. dog is classically the hardest pair in CIFAR-10 because ear shape and muzzle depth compress at 32x32.

label: deer
summary: Wild fallow, white-tailed, and woodland deer photographed standing in meadows, brush, or shaded forests.
visual_clues: Long slender neck, large flared ears, or branching antlers
Thin lower legs standing among green meadow grass or dry scrub
Tawny tan coat with pale underbelly or rump patch
imaging_notes: Profile silhouettes of does share long legs and brown coats with horses; head angle and neck thickness separate them.

label: dog
summary: Companion breeds, hounds, and working dogs photographed indoors, on lawns, or in close-up portraits.
visual_clues: Longer projecting snout and floppy or folded ears compared to cats
Wet dark nose prominence centered beneath the eyes
Standing or sitting canine chest contour with visible collar or paws
imaging_notes: Shallow 2-conv baselines frequently misclassify fluffy terriers and pugs as cats; batch normalization sharpens edges.

label: frog
summary: Amphibians resting on moss, rocks, lily pads, or hands with prominent bulbous eyes and crouching limbs.
visual_clues: Squat triangular body posture with folded hind thighs
Protruding dorsally placed eyes and mottled green, olive, or brown skin
Mossy, wet-stone, or aquatic leaf surroundings
imaging_notes: Textured green-brown amphibians often trip weak baselines when resting on speckled soil or wooden planks.

label: horse
summary: Saddled riding horses, foals, and pasture herds viewed laterally in paddocks or tracks.
visual_clues: Broad muscular neck topped by a mane and elongated equine head
Tall sturdy legs terminating in hooves over grass or dirt
Optional saddle, bridle, or rider seated high on the back
imaging_notes: Residual spatial pyramid features distinguish thicker equine necks and saddles from slender wild deer.

label: ship
summary: Cargo vessels, cruise liners, sailboats, and trawlers framed against open sea or harbor docks.
visual_clues: Strong horizontal hull line separating water reflections from sky
White superstructure bridge, smokestacks, cranes, or tall rigging masts
Open blue-grey ocean waves or harbor wake trailing the stern
imaging_notes: Waterline horizon edges give strong global cue separation from land-based trucks and bright sky planes.

label: truck
summary: Box trucks, semi-trailers, fire engines, and heavy commercial haulers parked or moving along highways.
visual_clues: Tall flat-sided cargo container or cab-over boxy silhouette
Elevated clearance over multi-axle wheels on tarmac
Large vertical windshield and chrome bumper grid
imaging_notes: Boxy front cabins vs. sloping sedans depend on roof-height ratios preserved well by padded 3x3 ResNet blocks.
